details.description: Sleepy Owl Original Cold Brew Coffee is a high-quality cold brew coffee made with Arabica coffee beans sourced directly from farms in Chikmagalur, Karnataka. The coffee is medium-roasted to achieve the perfect balance of dark and light flavours, resulting in a deep, characteristic chocolate taste. The cold brew process ensures a smooth, naturally sweet coffee with low acidity. The product is convenient to use, with each pack containing 45 g of coffee that can be brewed in cold water to make 3-5 cups of coffee, depending on your preferred strength.
details.usageInstructions: Brew in cold water. For 3 cups of regular strength Sleepy Owl, use 500 ml water. For 5 cups of light strength coffee, use 750 ml water and for 2 cups of extra strong coffee use 300 ml water. Once made, have it as you want - plain, heated, with milk, or for a special Vietnamese coffee, with condensed milk.

details.description: Sleepy Owl Brewpacks is a super convenient way to make high-quality cold brew coffee. Just leave a pack in a jar of water for 12 to 15 hours and wake up to a delicious cold brew. The dark roast brew packs are made with Arabica coffee from Chikmagalur, which has been dark roasted to bring out intense, complex notes of chocolate and nuts. The best part is you can customise the strength by adjusting the water quantity. Each pack contains 45 g of Arabica coffee, made with care at the brand's production facility in Delhi. Sleepy Owl's mission is to provide high-quality cold brew that can be enjoyed easily at home, work or on-the-go, without compromising on taste or health. The product contains no artificial additives, sugar or preservatives, and is vegan.
details.usageInstructions: Brew in cold water. For 3 cups of regular strength Sleepy Owl, use 500 ml water. For 5 cups of light strength coffee, use 750 ml water and for 2 cups of extra strong coffee use 300 ml water. Once made, have it as you want - plain, heated, with milk, or for a special Vietnamese coffee, with condensed milk.

details.description: This product is made from pure 100% Arabica coffee beans, giving you a nutty flavour and aroma of fresh vanilla beans. It is super simple to prepare at home, as no equipment is needed - you just have to add water and let it brew overnight. Once brewed, it stays fresh for a week when kept refrigerated, and you can enjoy the characteristic French Vanilla flavour whenever and wherever you wish.

Sleepy Owl Classic is a cold-brewed iced coffee made from the highest quality Grade A coffee sourced straight from Chikmagalur. The bottles contain 200ml of iced coffee and are made with love at our production facility in Ghaziabad. Each bottle has a shelf life of 120 days, which is achieved without any preservatives due to a special production process we use. The bottles are capped with easy-to-pull pop-off caps and have an ambient shelf life meaning they can be stored in cold or warm temperatures. These ready-to-drink bottles are India's first and only bottled iced coffee drink that contains nothing except coffee, milk, and sugar. No preservatives, no stabilisers, no emulsifiers, and no chemicals. Our mission at Sleepy Owl Coffee is to make high-quality cold brew coffee products that you can consume with ease and convenience at home, at work or on the go without having to compromise on taste or health.
